description: A Flutter widget implementing a turn panel UI for a Ludo game, displaying game status, player info, dice face, and action buttons.

classes.name: TurnPanel
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the game turn panel, including status display, controls for rolling dice, ending turn, and game management.

classes.name: _DiceFace
classes.description: A private widget displaying the dice face or rolling indicator.

classes.name: _ColorDot
classes.description: A private widget showing the player's color indicator.

classes.name: _UiColors
classes.description: A static class providing color mappings for player colors.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the TurnPanel widget UI based on current game state and parameters.
